text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm Sakura Laurel. I look forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the stage of my dreams. I have 
finally reached the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships lie in my way, I 
will overcome them and push forward—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
